title: Category Image
_note: Editor UI for the blog category banner/card image (the `categoryImage` field the frontend reads on Category — all-categories.graphql + category-by-slug.graphql). GraphQL is HAND-REGISTERED as Category.categoryImage: MediaItem in wp/mu-plugins/pod-category-image-register.php (so show_in_graphql is 0 here; wpgraphql-acf would otherwise expose it as a connection edge, not the flat MediaItem the committed schema declares). Field NAME `category_image` is the contract the resolver reads; KEY is site-prefixed ({{SITESLUG}}). GENERIC pattern — rename file + key prefix per site.

fields.name: category_image
fields.label: Category image
fields.instructions: Banner / card image for this category archive.
